sequenced-collections-concept-037.title: Use sequenced collections
sequenced-collections-concept-037.short: Work with collections that have encounter order
sequenced-collections-concept-037.summary: Java 21 introduced sequenced collection interfaces for collections with a defined first-to-last order.
sequenced-collections-concept-037.why: They provide common operations such as first, last, and reversed views across ordered collection types.
sequenced-collections-concept-037.tips: Use the most specific sequenced interface that matches the API contract.

record-pattern-concept-037.title: Deconstruct records with record patterns
record-pattern-concept-037.summary: Record patterns can test a record value and bind its components in one pattern.
record-pattern-concept-037.why: They reduce repetitive accessor calls when matching structured record data.
record-pattern-concept-037.tips: Combine them with instanceof or switch patterns when deconstruction improves clarity.

string-repeat-code-037.title: Repeat a string
string-repeat-code-037.summary: String.repeat creates a string by repeating the receiver a requested number of times.
string-repeat-code-037.why: It replaces manual loops for simple repeated text.
string-repeat-code-037.tips: Remember that a negative repeat count throws IllegalArgumentException.

invalid-path-exception-037.title: Handle invalid path syntax
invalid-path-exception-037.summary: InvalidPathException reports a path string that cannot be converted into a Path for the current file-system provider.
invalid-path-exception-037.why: Some characters or forms are not valid path syntax on a given platform.
invalid-path-exception-037.tips: Treat external path text as input and report invalid syntax clearly.

read-only-buffer-exception-037.title: Write to a read-only buffer
read-only-buffer-exception-037.short: Keep writable and read-only buffers distinct
read-only-buffer-exception-037.summary: ReadOnlyBufferException occurs when a modifying operation is attempted on a read-only buffer.
read-only-buffer-exception-037.why: A read-only view deliberately prevents changes through that buffer reference.
read-only-buffer-exception-037.tips: Retain a writable buffer when mutation is required and expose read-only views for consumers.

sealed-class-permits-error-037.title: Extend a sealed class without permission
sealed-class-permits-error-037.summary: A direct subclass of a sealed class must be permitted by the sealed hierarchy.
sealed-class-permits-error-037.why: Sealed classes explicitly control which types may directly extend or implement them.
sealed-class-permits-error-037.tips: Keep permits declarations and direct subtype modifiers consistent.

record-instance-field-error-037.title: Declare an extra instance field in a record
record-instance-field-error-037.short: Records cannot add instance state outside components
record-instance-field-error-037.summary: A record cannot declare additional instance fields beyond the state represented by its record components.
record-instance-field-error-037.why: The record header defines the complete instance state of the record.
record-instance-field-error-037.tips: Add another record component or use a normal class when extra mutable instance state is required.

serial-version-uid-warning-037.title: Omit serialVersionUID from a serializable class
serial-version-uid-warning-037.summary: The compiler can warn when a Serializable class does not declare serialVersionUID.
serial-version-uid-warning-037.why: An automatically computed identifier can change when class details change and break compatibility with stored data.
serial-version-uid-warning-037.tips: Declare an intentional serialVersionUID when Java serialization compatibility matters.

optional-or-else-eager-trap-037.title: Use Optional.orElse with expensive fallback work
optional-or-else-eager-trap-037.summary: The argument to orElse is evaluated before the method call even when the Optional already contains a value.
optional-or-else-eager-trap-037.why: Expensive or side-effecting fallback code can run unnecessarily.
optional-or-else-eager-trap-037.tips: Use orElseGet with a supplier when fallback creation should be lazy.

arrays-aslist-fixed-size-trap-037.title: Add elements to Arrays.asList result
arrays-aslist-fixed-size-trap-037.summary: Arrays.asList returns a list backed by the supplied array, so size-changing operations such as add and remove are unsupported.
arrays-aslist-fixed-size-trap-037.why: The list and array have a fixed one-to-one element layout.
arrays-aslist-fixed-size-trap-037.tips: Copy it into an ArrayList when a resizable list is required.
